name: Supreme Healing
entries: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature with a spell or Channel Divinity, don't roll those dice for the healing; instead use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring {@dice 2d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature with a spell, you restore 12.
